title: Singaporeans' Perception of Local Brands and Products
what_it_is: Singaporeans' Perception of Local Brands and Products

sections.label: Surveys and local brand support
sections.summary: Surveys on brand perception are not specific to local brands, and SPRING Singapore supports initiatives to raise awareness of local food products.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry))
sentences.text: While there have been surveys, like the Singapore Management University's Customer Satisfaction Index of Singapore and various surveys by private sector organisations, on consumers’ perception and satisfaction with various brands, these are not specific to Singaporeans' perception and awareness of local brands and products.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry))
sentences.text: We will consider doing such surveys as part of the work in implementing the ITMs.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry))
sentences.text: For instance, the Standards, Productivity and Innovation Board (SPRING) Singapore supported the recent collaboration between the Singapore Food Manufacturers' Association and Focus Network Agencies to help local food manufacturing companies feature their products through the Singapore Food Gifts Initiative at Changi Airport and amplify brand awareness.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry))
sentences.text: Participating companies were able to tap on SPRING Singapore's suite of assistance schemes, such as the Capability Development Grant, to support the packaging innovation, design and small batch production needed to commercialise these food gifts.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry))
sentences.text: This year, SPRING Singapore will also be collaborating with the National Trades Union Congress' FairPrice and Nanyang Polytechnic's (NYP's) School of Business Management to launch a Retail Incubator Programme.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry))
sentences.text: To date, more than 20 companies have expressed interest to list more than 40 items under this initiative.

sections.label: Design Orchard and homegrown brands
sections.summary: The November 2017 Boutiques Edit saw more attendees and sales, and JTC, SPRING Singapore and the Singapore Tourism Board will launch Design Orchard.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry))
sentences.text: The November 2017 Boutiques Edit showed a 50% increase in the number of attendees from the March 2017 edition, and quadrupled its sales, a signal that there is a growing appetite for designed-in-Singapore fashion and design.

sentences.speaker: The Senior Minister of State for Trade and Industry (Ms Sim Ann) (for the Minister for Trade and Industry (Industry))
sentences.text: To nurture homegrown brands and profile design talent, JTC, SPRING Singapore and the Singapore Tourism Board will launch the Design Orchard initiative, with more than 60 brands on board, along Orchard Road by the end of this year.

sections.label: Heartland retail and brand grooming
sections.summary: The heartlands are seen as a source of strong brands, and work is ongoing with the Federation of Merchants Association Singapore to rejuvenate heartland retail.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: Indeed, we see the heartlands as a very good source of potentially strong brands that can do Singapore proud.

sentences.speaker: Ms Sim Ann
sentences.text: I am also pleased to say that we are working very closely with the Federation of Merchants Association Singapore on how to rejuvenate retail in the heartlands and, we hope, in the process, continue to groom strong brands.
